step1_analysis.description: This circuit is a CML divide-by-2 stage, typically used as the core of a high-speed prescaler in a PLL. It consists of two latches in a master-slave configuration, where clocked tail transistors alternate the latches between track and hold phases to divide the input clock frequency by two.

paper_reference.title: A 2.4-GHz Monolithic Fractional-N Frequency Synthesizer With Robust Phase-Switching Prescaler and Loop Capacitance Multiplier

power_consumption.description: Average power dissipated by the divider stage.

sky130_expected.calculation: With VDD=1.8V and 500 ohm pull-up resistors, the tail current per latch is roughly 2mA. Total current ~4mA. Power = 4mA * 1.8V = 7.2mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for SKY130 1.8V supply and estimated 500 ohm load resistors required for CML operation.

input_frequency.description: The frequency of the input clock signal.

sky130_expected.calculation: Set by the testbench to match the paper's target application.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The synthesizer targets the 2.4 GHz ISM band.

output_frequency.description: The frequency of the divided output signal.

sky130_expected.calculation: Input frequency divided by 2. 2.4 GHz / 2 = 1.2 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: A divide-by-2 circuit must output exactly half the input frequency.

output_swing.description: Peak-to-peak voltage swing of the output nodes.

sky130_expected.reasoning: CML logic typically requires 0.6V to 1.2V swing to fully switch the differential pairs while keeping transistors in saturation.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to verify the divide-by-2 operation at 2.4 GHz, measure power consumption, and check output voltage swing. Pull-up resistors are added to complete the CML topology.
step3_testbench.spice:
* CML Divide-by-2 Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N4 LABEL_NET_0 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N8 LABEL_NET_1 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N6 N2 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N3 N2 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N2 N1 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N1 N3 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N2 N3 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N1 N6 N8 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N3 N6 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N6 N1 N8 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N5 LABEL_NET_2 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N0 LABEL_NET_3 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}

* Power Supply and CML Loads
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
R1 N1 VDD 500
R2 N2 VDD 500
R3 N3 VDD 500
R4 N6 VDD 500
VN7 N7 0 0

* Clock Sources (2.4 GHz)
* Period = 416.67ps, Half-period = 208.33ps
VCLK CLK 0 dc 0.9 pulse(0 1.8 0 20p 20p 188.33p 416.67p)
VCLKB CLKB 0 dc 0.9 pulse(1.8 0 0 20p 20p 188.33p 416.67p)

* Clock Connections to DUT
* Master Track / Slave Hold
V1 LABEL_NET_2 CLK 0
V2 LABEL_NET_1 CLK 0
* Master Hold / Slave Track
V3 LABEL_NET_0 CLKB 0
V4 LABEL_NET_3 CLKB 0

* Initial Conditions to speed up startup
.ic v(N1)=1.8 v(N6)=0.8 v(N2)=1.8 v(N3)=0.8

.control
tran 2p 10n

* Measure Power
meas tran I_vdd avg i(VVDD) from=5n to=10n
let power = -I_vdd * 1.8
print power

* Measure Input Frequency
meas tran t_in trig v(CLK) val=0.9 rise=10 targ v(CLK) val=0.9 rise=11
let in_freq = 1 / t_in
print in_freq

* Measure Output Frequency
meas tran t_out trig v(N1) val=1.3 rise=5 targ v(N1) val=1.3 rise=6
let out_freq = 1 / t_out
print out_freq

* Measure Output Swing
meas tran vmax max v(N1) from=5n to=10n
meas tran vmin min v(N1) from=5n to=10n
let swing = vmax - vmin
print swing

quit
.endc
